bucketDialog.bucketsHoldFilesWhoMayUse: Buckets hold files. Who may use them is set by Storage policies.
bucketDialog.name: Name
bucketDialog.publicBucketAnyoneCanReadFiles: Public bucketAnyone can read files by URL without signing in. Uploads, changes and deletes still follow your policies.
bucketDialog.everythingInThisBucketWillBe: Everything in this bucket will be readable by anyone with its URL.
bucketDialog.restrictFileSizeOtherwiseTheStack: Restrict file sizeOtherwise the stack's own limit (FILE_SIZE_LIMIT) applies.
bucketDialog.restrictFileTypesOnlyTheseMime: Restrict file typesOnly these MIME types can be uploaded.
bucketDialog.useTypesLikeImagePngOr: Use types like image/png or image/*, separated by commas.

fileSheet.noPreviewTheFileSizeIs: No preview: the file size is unknown.
fileSheet.noPreviewForThisTypeOf: No preview for this type of file.
fileSheet.anyoneWithThisLinkCanOpen: Anyone with this link can open the file.
fileSheet.signedUrlsWorkForAnyoneWho: Signed URLs work for anyone who has them until they expire, and can't be revoked early.
fileSheet.theFullPathInThisBucket: The full path in this bucket, e.g. archive/2026/report.pdf

storageBuckets.thisFolderIsEmptyDropFiles: This folder is empty. Drop files here, or use Upload files.
storageBuckets.name: Name
storageBuckets.showingTheFirst1000Items: Showing the first 1,000 items in this folder.
storageBuckets.foldersAreDeletedWithEverythingInside: Folders are deleted with everything inside them. This can’t be undone.
storageBuckets.thisCanTBeUndoneLinks: This can’t be undone; links to these files stop working.
storageBuckets.filesWithTheseNamesAlreadyExist: Files with these names already exist in this folder. Replacing them overwrites the old versions.
storageBuckets.foldersAreKeptWithAnEmpty: Folders are kept with an empty placeholder file, as in Supabase Studio.
storageBuckets.containersForFilesOpenOneTo: Containers for files. Open one to browse, upload and share its files.
storageBuckets.noBucketsYetCreateOneTo: No buckets yet. Create one to start storing files.
storageBuckets.everyFileInItIsDeleted: Every file in it is deleted now. This can't be undone.
storageBuckets.itsFilesAreDeletedFirstThen: Its files are deleted first, then the bucket. This can't be undone.
storageBuckets.everyFileCounted_one: Every file in it is deleted now ({{count}} file). This can't be undone.
storageBuckets.everyFileCounted_other: Every file in it is deleted now ({{count}} files). This can't be undone.

storagePolicies.policiesOnStorageSTablesDecide: Policies on Storage's tables decide who can read, upload, change and delete files through the API. Without any, only the service key can.

storageS3.storageSpeaksTheS3ProtocolSo: Storage speaks the S3 protocol, so S3 tools and SDKs can read and write its buckets.
storageS3.makingNewKeysStorageRestartsWith: Making new keys; Storage restarts with them
storageS3.theStackIsBusyWaitFor: The stack is busy; wait for it to finish
storageS3.storageAcceptsAnyRegionInRequests: Storage accepts any region in requests; use this one.
storageS3.selfHostedStorageTakesTheAccess: Self-hosted Storage takes the access key pair from the stack's .env (S3_PROTOCOL_ACCESS_KEY_ID, S3_PROTOCOL_ACCESS_KEY_SECRET) and the region from REGION.
storageS3.supermixerConnectsToThisStackSo: Supermixer connects to this stack, so its S3 keys are where it runs
storageS3.oneKeyPairForTheWhole: One key pair for the whole stack. It can read and write every bucket, past any Row Level Security policy, like the secret API key: keep it on servers.
storageS3.withTheAwsCliOtherS3: With the AWS CLI; other S3 clients take the same endpoint, region and keys, with path-style addressing.
storageS3.s3ClientsUsingTheCurrentKeys: S3 clients using the current keys stop working. Storage restarts with the new ones, so uploads in progress may fail.

storageSettings.limitsAndFeaturesOfThisProject: Limits and features of this project's Storage.
storageSettings.selfHostedStorageReadsThemFrom: Self-hosted Storage reads them from its service's environment in the stack's compose file: FILE_SIZE_LIMIT (bytes) and ENABLE_IMAGE_TRANSFORMATION. Projects created with “Create a new stack” are configured here.
storageSettings.supermixerConnectsToThisStackSo: Supermixer connects to this stack, so its Storage settings are set where it runs
storageSettings.savedStorageRestartedWithTheNew: Saved; Storage restarted with the new settings
storageSettings.savedTheyTakeEffectWhenThe: Saved; they take effect when the stack starts
storageSettings.onlyOwnersAndAdministratorsCanChange: Only Owners and Administrators can change Storage settings
storageSettings.storageIsGivenItAsIt: Storage is given it as it is, and the setting below shows its default. Save it as shown, or change it, to replace the value.
storageSettings.savedSettingsTakeEffectWhenIt: Saved settings take effect when it starts.
storageSettings.theLargestFileAnyoneCanUpload: The largest file anyone can upload, in any bucket. A bucket's own limit can only be lower. Between 1 KB and 500 GB.
storageSettings.resizeAndConvertImagesOnThe: Resize and convert images on the fly, through render URLs (imgproxy). Turning it off refuses those requests.
storageSettings.theUploadLimitMustBeBetween: The upload limit must be between 1 KB and 500 GB
storageSettings.savingRestartsStorageSoUploadsIn: Saving restarts Storage, so uploads in progress may fail. S3 clients connect as described under <link>S3 Connection</link>.

storageApi.bucketNamesCanBeAtMost: Bucket names can be at most 100 characters.
